videos.headline: Phil Mafah muscles into end zone to put Clemson up late
videos.description: Phil Mafah scores the short touchdown to put Clemson on top in the Gator Bowl.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Phil Mafah muscles into end zone to put Clemson up late) 2023/12/29 ESHEET

videos.headline: Kentucky's Barion Brown scores the opening TD on a sweep
videos.description: Barion Brown takes the handoff on a sweep play and proceeds to haul across the goal line for a Kentucky touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Kentucky's Barion Brown scores the opening TD on a sweep) 2023/12/29 ESHEET

videos.headline: Re'Mahn Davis breaks out for a 43-yard run against Clemson
videos.description: Kentucky's offensive line makes space for Re'Mahn Davis to cut up the middle for a 43-yard rush.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Re'Mahn Davis breaks out for a 43-yard run against Clemson) 2023/12/29 ESHEET

videos.headline: Phil Mafah plows through the line to score a Clemson TD
videos.description: Phil Mafah wills his way across the goal line, scoring the first touchdown for Clemson vs. Kentucky.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Phil Mafah plows through the line to score a Clemson TD) 2023/12/29 ESHEET

videos.headline: Dane Key helps Kentucky regain the lead with a 58-yard play and a TD
videos.description: Dane Key brings home a 58-yard catch to put Kentucky in good field position, then he finishes the drive with a touchdown catch from Devin Leary.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCF Highlight (Dane Key helps Kentucky regain the lead with a 58-yard play and a TD) 2023/12/29 ESHEET

videos.headline: Barion Brown sets Gator Bowl record with 100-yard kickoff return
videos.description: Kentucky's Barion Brown gets hot and hauls in a magnificent 100-yard kick return, the longest return in Gator Bowl history.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Barion Brown sets Gator Bowl record with 100-yard kickoff return) 2023/12/29 ESHEET

videos.headline: Phil Mafah cuts the deficit at the goal line with a TD
videos.description: Phil Mafah muscles his way across the goal line for a touchdown, making it a 21-16 deficit for the Tigers.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Phil Mafah cuts the deficit at the goal line with a TD) 2023/12/29 ESHEET

videos.headline: Clemson's Xavier Thomas strip-sacks Devin Leary
videos.description: Xavier Thomas strip-sacks Devin Leary to give Clemson possession of the ball early in the 4th quarter.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Clemson's Xavier Thomas strip-sacks Devin Leary) 2023/12/29 ESHEET

videos.headline: Devin Leary's ball gets tipped then picked by Barrett Carter
videos.description: Clemson's defense kicks it up a notch, forcing an interception on Barrett Carter after his pass attempt is tipped.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Devin Leary's ball gets tipped then picked by Barrett Carter) 2023/12/29 ESHEET

videos.headline: Clemson takes lead with a TD after the defense forces a fumble
videos.description: Khalil Barnes makes a clutch defensive play by forcing the fumble, then Phil Mafah converts with an 18-yard touchdown giving Clemson the lead.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Clemson takes lead with a TD after the defense forces a fumble) 2023/12/29 ESHEET

videos.headline: Barion Brown's 60-yard TD puts Kentucky in front
videos.description: Devin Leary connects with Barion Brown for a 60-yard touchdown giving the Wildcats the lead.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Barion Brown's 60-yard TD puts Kentucky in front) 2023/12/29 ESHEET

videos.headline: Clemson's Shelton Lewis snags a clutch INT late to seal the win
videos.description: Clemson's Shelton Lewis picks off Devin Leary late in the fourth quarter to cap the Tigers' Gator Bowl victory.
